item.description: - PQ's minority government has a historically low mandate, so expect instability, not certainty, on any referendum timeline. - Ottawa's fall budget has less fiscal room than hoped, since oil-price tax gains are largely already spent. - Defence spending is set to rise sharply, with the PBO pricing NATO compliance at over 163 billion dollars by 2035. - Manitoba's PC opposition is in leadership limbo after Obby Khan's sudden resignation, reshaping the legislature dynamic. - Bank of Canada holds at 2.25 per cent for now, next decision October 28.

item.title: 2026-10-07 Climate Policy & Nonprofit Governance: Alberta's major oil producers and pipeline companies are staying out of the referendum debate
item.description: - Alberta's oil and pipeline companies stayed off the national unity letter, staying neutral on the referendum. - Manitoba is now first in Canada offering zero-cost green retrofits to lower-income households.

item.title: 2026-10-07 AI & Technology: AI Money Moves: Lambda, Mistral, and Agent Friction
item.description: - Lambda's four billion dollar raise leans on one client, Anthropic, that's a concentration risk worth naming. - Anthropic is subsidizing startup adoption with free Claude Team access and credits. - Mistral's trillion-parameter model is Europe's bid to not fall behind the US and China. - Amazon and Walmart are blocking AI shopping agents, agentic commerce has real friction left. - LibreOffice selling "no AI" shows a privacy-first counter-trend worth watching in client software choices.

item.title: 2026-10-07 Health & Fitness: Cartilage Regrowth, Recovery Windows, and New GLP-1 Rules
item.description: - Stanford protein-blocking study regrew cartilage in mice, human tissue responded too, but it's early and commercially tied to a startup. - Pilates isn't just for flexibility, it's injury prevention for runners and lifters alike. - Skip training more than two weeks and cardio fitness drops first, strength lasts longer. - WHO's new childhood obesity guidance allows GLP-1s for some teens, lifestyle first. - Ontario regulator tightening safer supply prescribing rules, a story to watch provincially.

item.title: 2026-10-07 Parenting: Bigger Child Benefit Cheques and New Paediatric Guidance
item.description: - Canada Child Benefit rose again this July: $8,157 per child under six, $6,883 for ages six to seventeen. - Full benefit cuts off near $37,500 in household net income, worth checking against a client's year end numbers. - Canadian Paediatric Society's 2026 to 2027 flu shot guidance is out, ahead of the usual winter surge. - CPS is also surveying parents this month on kids' screen time, tied to proposed federal online safety legislation. - For RESP clients, Ottawa still matches twenty percent of contributions, so starting early still compounds best.

item.title: 2026-10-07 Sports: Raiders Fall to Chiefs, Jets Host Avalanche Tonight
item.description: - Raiders drop first game of the season, 30-27 to Kansas City, now face the Patriots. - Jets on your watch list, hosting Colorado tonight at Canada Life Centre. - NFL suspended two officials this week over conduct toward players. - Panthers' Barkov out six to eight weeks, no surgery required. - Stamkos now 17th all-time in NHL scoring, passing Sakic and Iginla.
